name: Banan Incremental
summary:
# Banan Incremental
(This game is currently in early-access! Please report any and all bugs to the Discord!)

VR's first incremental game, all about collecting Banan and much more!

- Buy Banan and buy upgrades to earn even more.
- Perform resets to earn special currency, to earn even more Banan.
- Reach values never seen before!
- Play daily for extra boosts and cosmetics!
- Compete to be at the top of the leaderboards.

How much Banan can you collect?
